title: Hardening S2: Remove the self-staleness sync/doctor ratchet
description: Every mutation marks ledgers/search/sqlite stale and emits doctor.recovery.required; workflows tell agents to satisfy required directives before the next mutation; the repair commands re-stale state and log operations that trip operation.volume. Agent 2 ran ~12 sync+doctor cycles to close 3 tasks. Health enforcement moves to the gate. Sources: audit findings e-g.
acceptanceCriteria: All child tasks closed with commit checkpoints
Closing a task via documented workflow emits zero mid-stream health directives in a healthy workspace
closedReason: Sprint acceptance criteria met; commit checkpoint recorded as dirty-path evidence because unrelated pre-existing staged and dirty changes prevent a scoped commit.
